fields.Name: T208 - Edit Date Field and Save
fields.Description: Changes a date field value on an Event record using the date picker and saves, verifying date field editing.

InputDefinition.goal: Open the 'Events' entity grid — type 'Events' in the LEFT sidebar 'Search entities...' box and click the exact 'Events' node (or, if the search is giving you trouble, navigate directly to http://localhost:4200/app/data-explorer/Data?entity=Events). Click a row, then click 'Open Full Record'. Find a date field on the form (for example 'Start Date' or 'Registration Open Date'). Change its value to a different date (click the field to open the date picker and pick a day, or type a valid date). An unsaved-changes 'Save Changes' banner appears at the TOP — click 'Save Changes'. Verify the save succeeds with no error. Pages can take 10-30s to load — wait, don't navigate away.

judgeValidationCriteria: A date field's value was changed on an Event record (via the date picker or typing)
Save Changes was clicked and the save succeeded with no error
No error messages or crash pages
